fusions.name: Chewing Rotors
fusions.desc: Spins a ring of chewing rotors that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Stripping Drone
fusions.desc: Launches a stripping drone that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, with 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Clockwork Cloud
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to release a cloud of clockwork insects for 12 seconds that chews an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Harvest Counter
fusions.desc: Every kill ticks a counter on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per tick (15% at full). Unfed, a tick fades every 10 seconds.
